entries.title: Fixed Double Foot and T Grip Floor Pump
entries.description: One newly authored complete static T-handle floor-pump appearance. A continuous broad double-wing foot with two finite pads supports a tall thick bored cylinder, full upper gland and independent fixed raised plunger rod. One full transverse T shaft carries two whole palm grips. A low tilted round housing has a recessed blank opaque face; one continuous curved hose runs from its lower side socket around to a short fixed chuck retained at the upper barrel. The chuck has a finite mouth recess and a complete short lever. All numeric geometry new, not the village water pump with its spout removed, nor a barrel extracted from the paired-crank bell-chamber bench. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and bounds-centred grounded origin; one prop zero scenes. Fixed exterior only: no pressure readings, pumping, inflation, internal valves, air circuit, hose compatibility, plunger or chuck motion, ergonomics, manufacturing, operating instructions or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Single-Cell and Raised-Plunger Soil Block Former
entries.description: One newly authored complete static single-cell soil-block-former appearance in a fixed raised-plunger display pose. A thick square forming sleeve has genuine whole top and bottom apertures, not a capped container. One separate close-profile square ejector plate sits visibly above the open chamber and carries a central short downward dibble. A tall continuous open side-grip arch is rooted in the sleeve, while the separate central plunger stem rises through the arch to its own full transverse grip. The empty chamber, raised plate, downward projection and nested outer/inner handle relationship are the entire new apparatus, not extra tray cells, a solid tamper scaled up or an arbor press with its gearing removed. Every coordinate newly authored; only generic solid/export tools reused. One model zero scenes. Fixed intentional overlap assembly, opaque materials. No actual sliding clearance, pressing/ejection stroke, soil compaction, seed-hole dimensions, plant growth, force, ergonomics, manufacture or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Separated Vessel Negative Mould Halves
entries.description: One newly authored complete separated two-part ceramic-casting-mould exterior, counted as one set rather than two repeated new models. Each whole thick rectangular half contains one genuinely concave half-round bottle-shaped negative cavity: a tapered closed lower end, broad body, changing shoulder, narrow neck and an open exit through the upper end wall. All material walls, parting faces and bottom remain one closed shared-vertex mesh per half. Two complete locating-pin exteriors on one half correspond visually to two real blind locator cups on the other. Both whole parts are laid face-up with a positive gap, not shown assembled or operating. This differs from the old one-sided shallow scalloped food mould and raised die on a handle, and from a freestanding amphora: there is no vessel wall or imported jar split into pieces, only newly authored negative body boundaries inside full support blocks. Two opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and both complete undersides grounded. One whole craft prop zero scenes. Generic static mould-inspired art only: no slip, liquid, casting, draft/release validation, shrinkage, assembly fit, absorbency, material authenticity, production dimensions, manufacture or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Perforated Well and Retracted Hood Vacuum Former
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty vacuum-former-style desktop machine exterior. A deep open rectangular well has a full floor and thick walls, with a genuinely perforated thick table supported inside. A complete lower aperture ring surrounds the well; a separate entire empty clamp ring is fixed raised on one full transverse rear pivot and has its own open front hand loop. Two rear carrier standards and long parallel rails support one broad downward-recessed overhead hood in a visibly retracted rear pose, with an inset opaque blank panel and full pull handle. One long side lever and cross-grip, a blank front control face and four complete grounded pads belong to this single integrated machine. All geometry newly drawn, no old screen-print frame, cup-sealer head, appliance case or grille imported. Unlike the raised mesh screen over a cantilever garment platen, the new table is a perforated plate inside a deep well and the raised clamp has no mesh; the independent rear retracted hood and side table lever are part of the whole relation. Unlike the cup-sealer there are no paired supply rolls, stretched film web or extended circular tray. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR materials, metres/native Z up/front -Y, true horizontal whole-bounds centre and pad-bottom datum. No sheet, mould, plastic material or heating coil supplied. Static illustrative exterior only: no vacuum, gas circuit, pump, heat, electrical function, clamping seal, lifting, sliding, forming, manufacturing process, operating instructions, capacity, pressure, material suitability, ergonomics or safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made or verified.

entries.title: Whole Branch-Suspended Angular Wingcase Chrysalis
entries.description: One newly authored complete static stylised hanging chrysalis-like natural prop with its whole bent woody support. The suspended shell is one continuous closed angular body: a broad faceted lower head and paired long wing-case shoulders merge into a narrower transversely waisted upper abdomen and an integral thin hanging terminal attachment. Longitudinal keel changes and broad inset sloping wing-case faces are actual surface geometry, not a caterpillar stripped of legs or butterfly wings folded as separate panels. The entire twig has a finite cut base, rising uneven stem and overhanging bent top that actually seats the terminal tip. One whole prop zero scenes or additional growth stages. Fixed opaque artistic exterior only; no exact species, biological scale, developmental timing, emergence, living specimen, internal anatomy, gripping strength, simulation or animation claim.
